subject: Clinical AI pilot — follow-up and MAP
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@apexhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Clinical AI pilot — follow-up and MAP

Hi Sarah — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from my side and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) so we have alignment and clear owners.

Key pain & goals we heard
- High false-positive rate in triage routing (current rule-based system). Goal: reduce triage false positives by 30% in Q1 pilot.
- Latency constraints: model output must arrive within 250ms for triage median.
- Data privacy: PHI stays in Apex's VPC; we discussed Private deployment options.

What we proposed on the call
- 6-week technical pilot: small cohort (3 hospitals), dedicated inference nodes, telemetry to measure latency, cost, and precision/recall by case type.
- Evaluation criteria: throughput, 99th latency, precision/recall delta vs baseline, and integration effort estimate.

Immediate next steps (items I own / you own)
1) Ben (Redwood): Share MAP spreadsheet and pilot scope doc by end of day Monday (attached).
2) Sarah (Apex): Share sample de-identified triage logs and legal contact for data transfer by Wednesday.
3) Monica (Redwood Solutions): Prep high-level architecture diagram and short checklist for on-prem connector options.
4) Marissa (CS): Outline success metrics dashboard we will instrument.

Proposed milestone dates (tentative)
- Nov 9: MAP v1 and pilot scope (Ben)
- Nov 16: Data handoff and legal contact intro (Sarah)
- Nov 23: Internal kickoff at Apex + tech onboarding (joint)
- Dec 14: Mid-pilot checkpoint + metrics review
- Jan 8: Pilot close and go/no-go decision

Attachments I included: MAP_ApexHealth_v1.xlsx (single-tab milestone/owner table), pilot-scope-summary.pdf (1-page scope).

Let me know if edits to milestone dates or owners are needed — happy to shift. If this looks good I can lock the MAP and send a calendar invite for the Nov 23 kickoff.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@apexhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@apexhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clinical AI pilot — follow-up and MAP

Thanks Ben — appreciate the crisp recap. A few clarifications from our side:
- The 30% reduction target is directional; clinical leads want to make sure sensitivity doesn't drop below current thresholds. We'll treat precision/recall delta as primary success metric.
- Latency target clarity: the 250ms median is fine but can we document p95 and p99 SLOs in the MAP? That matters for integration with our streaming bus.
- Data handoff: I'll send de-identified triage logs to Monica and your data team by Wednesday EOD; cc'ing Procurement so they see the timeline for legal review.

Procurement note: procurement@apexhealth.com - we're aiming to use our standard pilot MSA with a limited data addendum. Can you share Redwood's MSA template or tell us where to request a redline?

Agree with Nov 23 kickoff — that's our target too. Please include a brief agenda (30 min tech sync + 30 min stakeholder alignment).

Regards,
Sarah Lee
Director, Clinical Innovation | Apex Health
sarah.lee@apexhealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@apexhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@apexhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clinical AI pilot — follow-up and MAP

Sarah — perfect, thanks for the confirmations and the procurement note. Actions below reflect your clarifications; I've updated the MAP milestones and added SLO rows for p95/p99 latency. Attaching MAP v1 (spreadsheet) and short scope PDF for your legal/procurement review.

Updated mutual action plan (compact)
- Owner: Ben (Redwood) — Deliver MAP v1, MSA template, and kickoff agenda by Mon Nov 9.
- Owner: Sarah (Apex) — Deliver de-identified sample logs and legal contact intro by Wed Nov 11.
- Owner: Monica (Redwood Solutions) — Provide on-prem connector checklist and architecture diagram by Thu Nov 12.
- Owner: Marissa (CS) — Dashboard spec + instrumentation plan by Nov 16.

Milestone dates (locked for calendar invites)
- Nov 9: MAP v1 + MSA template sent (Ben)
- Nov 11: Data handoff + legal intro (Sarah)
- Nov 12: Connector design review (Monica)
- Nov 16: Dashboard and instrumentation plan (Marissa)
- Nov 23: Technical kickoff (joint)
- Dec 14: Mid-pilot checkpoint (joint)
- Jan 8: Pilot close & decision (joint)

Risk & blockers
- Legal turn time: if procurement requires >15 business days for redlines we may need a short-term data-sharing workstream.
- Data quality: if triage logs need extra labeling we should budget 1 week for annotation prep.

Next immediate ask
- Sarah: confirm procurement's preferred MSA contact and any standard clauses to expect.
- Apex tech: share a sample one-hour slot for Nov 23 kickoff (ideally morning PST).

I'll push calendar invites after I hear back on preferred slots. Thanks again — excited to get this moving.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
